comment.text: MAX R60 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Hematologic neoplasms; Bowel tumors; CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Colorectal carcinoma. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting MAX residue R60 have been observed in colorectal carcinoma, low-grade glioma, and endometrial carcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
